proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D E hAB hBC hCD hDA hAC hBD
  have add : ∀ X Y Z W : P, Y ≠ X → Y ≠ W → Sbtw ℝ X W Z →
      EuclideanGeometry.angle X Y Z = EuclideanGeometry.angle X Y W + EuclideanGeometry.angle W Y Z := by
    intro X Y Z W hYX hYW hW
    have t1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi W hYX
    have t2 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi Z hYW
    have t3 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi Z hYX
    have l := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi Y hW.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
    have e1 := hW.angle_eq_left Y
    have e2 := hW.symm.angle_eq_right Y
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm Z W Y] at t2
    linarith
  have a1 := add D A B E hDA.symm hAC.ne_left.symm hBD.symm
  have a2 := add A B C E hAB.symm hBD.ne_left.symm hAC
  have a3 := add B C D E hBC.symm hAC.ne_right.symm hBD
  have a4 := add C D A E hCD.symm hBD.ne_right.symm hAC.symm
  have t1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi E hAB.symm
  have t2 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi E hBC.symm
  have t3 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi E hCD.symm
  have t4 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi E hDA.symm
  have l1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi B hAC.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
  have l2 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi D hAC.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
  linarith [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C E B, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm A E D]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D E : P), A ≠ B → B ≠ C → C ≠ D → D ≠ A → Sbtw ℝ A E C → Sbtw ℝ B E D → EuclideanGeometry.angle D A B + EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C + EuclideanGeometry.angle B C D + EuclideanGeometry.angle C D A = 2 * Real.pi
